name: CONSOLIDATA Growth Decision Assessment
audience: Startup company owners, chief executives, product leads and marketing leaders in the United States and Canada; current focus is at least one venture-funding round in the past three years, existing users or customers and growth below expectations

price.tax: Additional where applicable, shown before payment

structure: Six common questions plus six groups of four: reach, response, first useful result, purchase, continued use and evidence
actionStatus: Start assessment; answer or defer 30 questions; review; save work email; review US$99 report purchase and applicable tax; payment enabled only when payment and report-email services are ready
deliverable: Initial answer-based report preserving written context, plausible explanations for selected symptom areas, four customer-value questions, one proposed bounded evidence check and the complete answer record; emailed as a report attachment after server-verified payment
method: Consistent question-bank rules using symptom and evidence-category selections; written answers and notes retained as context
limitations: All submitted information is self-reported and not independently verified
No external artificial intelligence model interprets the written answers
No certified single cause, outcome probability or guaranteed growth, sales or profit
No human advisory review, interviews or campaign execution included
No public full-report display, download or export endpoint
Email-service acceptance does not prove inbox delivery
Follow-on services separately scoped and agreed
Saving a work email does not verify address ownership or subscribe the visitor to marketing
Payment willingness or funding alone does not establish suitability or the cause of a growth problem
